thread.title: Apple's stock surge on track to add nearly 60 points to Dow's price

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Apple's stock surge on track to add nearly 60 points to Dow's price
text: Shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, +5.24% shot up 4.5% toward a record high in premarket trade Wednesday, bucking the weakness in the broader market, after the technology giant beat fiscal third-quarter earnings and revenue expectations . The stock was on track to open above the July 25 record closing price of $194.82, and above the July 26 all-time intraday high of $195.96 seen during regular trading hours of $195.96. The premarket stock price gain would add about 58 points to the Dow Jones Industrial Average's DJIA, +0.02% price, while Dow futures YMU8, +0.04% were down 31 points.
